title: 472,674 properties get addresses
why: MACRA figures: 472,674 properties numbered and 11,367 streets named under the National Addressing System.

title: MACRA introduces National Addressing System in Machinga
why: NAS being introduced district by district; Malawi lacks comprehensive addressing.

title: Street naming exercise underway in some district councils
why: Street naming in Blantyre, Zomba, Lilongwe and Mzuzu under the National Addressing System.

title: MACRA Rolls Out National Addressing System to Boost Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene Services
why: NAS rolled out in all districts; links to water and sanitation services.

title: MACRA rolls out 'National Addressing System'
why: NAS rolled out to all districts, districts have postcodes; street naming being finalised.

title: Experts emphasize importance of national addressing system in Malawi
why: MACRA says standards developed 2018, pilots in Blantyre and Lilongwe, national implementation started; mandate under Communications Act 2016.

title: Creating order through National Addressing System
why: No official addressing system across Malawi; NAS phased rollout since 2019, aim all districts by 2025.

title: National Addressing Project
why: Project description: postcodes, standards, address database, GIS; benefits for emergency services and tax.
